description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for accessing LoanChargePaidBy entities, including a custom query to find charge payment mappings associated with loans without installment numbers.

classes.name: LoanChargePaidByRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for LoanChargePaidBy entities, providing CRUD and custom query methods.

methods.name: findChargePaidByMappingsWithoutInstallmentNumber
methods.description: Custom method executing a JPQL query to retrieve LoanChargePaidBy records linked with loan transactions that match specified conditions, notably excluding installment numbers.
